headline: Kühne+Nagel navigates corporate governance following founder's death
summary: Following the passing of Klaus-Michael Kühne, Swiss-based logistics giant Kühne+Nagel is managing leadership continuity and historical reviews of the company's legacy.
why: Kühne+Nagel International AG is one of the world's largest freight forwarding and supply chain logistics firms.

impacts.name: Kühne + Nagel International AG
impacts.why: Management transitions shape long-term strategic direction for logistics providers.
